title: French Prospective Cohort of Innovative Endoscopic Interventions in Expert Centers
official: French Prospective Cohort of Innovative Endoscopic Interventions in Expert Centers
summary: The creation of a multi-center French cohort pooling data from innovative endoscopies carried out in France every year would make it possible to produce excellent scientific results and analyze on a large scale the results of our current practices.

interventions.name: Effectiveness of diagnostic and therapeutic and/or innovative endoscopic techniques

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients \> 18 yo
* Patient able to give consent
* Patient with innovative endoscopy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Opposition to participation in the present project to be notified in the file
* Patient under court protection
